name: DIAL3D
short_description: AI voice, chat, and admissions platform for addiction treatment and mental health facilities with real-time insurance verification and crisis protocols.
long_description: DIAL3D is an AI-powered voice, chat, and admissions platform built specifically for addiction treatment, mental health, and detox facilities. The platform handles inbound calls and intake with sub-2-second response times, performs real-time insurance verification (VOB lookup), and includes built-in crisis protocols that immediately warm-transfer to human staff or 988 when needed. Founded by operators from multi-facility treatment programs, DIAL3D integrates with major behavioral health EHRs including Kipu, Sunwave, Lightning Step, and BestNotes. Most single-facility programs can go live within two business days.
one_liner: AI voice and admissions platform for addiction and mental health treatment centers.
best_for: Addiction treatment centers needing 24/7 admissions coverage
Multi-facility behavioral health organizations with high call volumes
Mental health facilities wanting AI-assisted intake with human escalation
Treatment centers requiring real-time insurance verification during intake
not_for: Solo practitioners or small private practices
Practices not focused on admissions-heavy workflows

pricing.notes: Trial: Free (100 voice minutes, $0.49/min after). Professional: $2,000/month (5 agents, 10 numbers, $0.44/min, web chat). Enterprise: Custom pricing (unlimited agents/numbers, omnichannel, dedicated support). BAA included on all plans.

compliance.notes: HIPAA-aligned environment with logged access, encrypted transport, and minimum-necessary retention. BAA signed on every plan including 30-day pilots. SOC 2 Type II audit opened Feb 2026, report available Q3 2026 under NDA. 42 CFR Part 2 disclosure handling supported.

faqs.q: What EHRs does DIAL3D integrate with?
faqs.a: DIAL3D integrates with 32+ platforms including Kipu, Sunwave, Lightning Step, BestNotes, Salesforce Health Cloud, HubSpot, and CallTrackingMetrics.

faqs.q: How does DIAL3D handle crisis situations?
faqs.a: The crisis-line protocol fires immediately when needed. The AI agent stays on the line with a slower, trauma-informed cadence and warm-transfers to a human within three seconds - either to a designated clinician during business hours or 988 after hours.
